criteria.hypothesis: Students will pay 20 EGP for an exam-time water reminder app
criteria.metric: Share of people shown the offer who pre-order

behavioral_metric.why: Metric must count an action people take (opt-in, sign-up, pre-order, use), not opinions.

can_fail.why: Needs a success threshold, a lower adverse trigger and a sample floor, so the test can fail.

low_cost_within_budget.why: Cost estimate must be stated as a number and fit the budget (UNKNOWN).

honest_consent.why: Participants must knowingly consent; no deception.

founder_runs_it.why: The founder runs it personally; FounderOS never contacts anyone.

no_prohibited_tactic.why: No fake sign-ups, impersonation, payments or other never-rules.

real_action_not_simulated.why: The test describes a simulated or hypothetical action. Rewrite it as a real, voluntary action, or mark it SIMULATED / NOT COUNTED.

experiment.notice: DRAFT. Lock it (pre-register) BEFORE collecting data. A planned experiment is never evidence.
